summary: The proposal has major structural and compliance issues, including a missing abstract, excessive length, and a problem section that inappropriately proposes a solution. Additional concerns involve unclear objectives, brief figure captions, and several writing style violations. Significant revisions are required before the proposal can be considered ready for submission.

findings.title: Missing Abstract section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Abstract section, which is required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Proposal exceeds allowed length
findings.description: The document spans 10 pages of content, which is longer than the maximum allowed 4‑6 pages for the main text of the proposal.

findings.title: Problem section includes a solution proposal
findings.description: The Problem section should only describe the problem and its negative consequences, but it contains a sentence proposing a self‑service platform as a solution.

locations.quote: A **self-service platform that arms the workfow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would end this accumulation**.

findings.title: Objective uses double verbs
findings.description: Objective bullet **Design and implement connectors with expiry** contains two verbs, which violates the rule that each objective should be formulated with a single action verb.

findings.title: Caption for Figure 2 is too short
findings.description: Figure captions must be long and informative. The caption for Figure 2 is only "System Architecture" which is generic and insufficient.

findings.title: Contraction usage
findings.description: The text contains a contraction, which violates the rule prohibiting contractions.

locations.quote: The current process **doesn’t** scale and is the worst bottleneck of the chair.

findings.title: Superlative word usage
findings.description: A superlative ('worst') is used, which is discouraged in the writing style guidelines.

locations.quote: The current process doesn’t scale and is the **worst** bottleneck of the chair.
